annotations.title: Fetch a Paisán supplier or product

description: The details of one result from search, by its id ("supplier:…" or "product:…"). Every supplier is named. No contact details are included. To contact a supplier, send the buyer to its profileUrl on paisan.net (free to search). Software agents can buy one supplier's contact record through Paisán's paid agent API (/api/agent/v1/suppliers/{id}, see https://paisan.net/openapi.json).

id.description: An id from the search tool, such as "supplier:abc123" or "product:xyz".

name: fetch
